svg.title: TYPE_CLEAN_GARAGE -> PlanCleanGarageJob()
svg.desc: Tidy up when there is no other work: park idle AGVs out of the way under trays, and put trays that an earlier plan left on waypoints back into parking.
svg.metadata: ["Start: the request arrives. The map is working_state as the method first sees it; no events yet. Step through the method one table row at a time.", "Row 1. Make a scratch copy of the request's garage and apply every event already in the DAG, so the method sees the garage as earlier jobs will leave it. In this example: Empty DAG. (replay)", "Row 2. Only the first successful job of a request hides AGVs: ask HideAgvs (motion_planner) for one hiding pose per AGV. In this example: First job, so AGVs are hidden. HideAgvs (motion_planner) returns the first assignment it finds, one hiding pose per AGV (AGV-1 -> P24, AGV-2 -> P15 here, illustrative). (hiding spots)", "Row 3. If no hiding assignment exists, the job fails. In this example: It succeeded. (skipped)", "Row 4. Add one AgvMove per AGV that is not already hidden, chained per AGV (and per bay when hiding in a bay). In this example: No rule B: the hide moves do not wait for each other. (adds 1, 2)", "Row 5. Find trays left standing on waypoints by an earlier tier-2 stash. In this example: T9 was left on waypoint W25 by an earlier tier-2 stash. (T9 found)", "Row 6. Plan each of them back into parking; destination left for tray assignment. Failures are only logged. In this example: Rule B: both hide moves are leaves of this job, so 3 waits for 1 and 2. (adds 3 \u00b7 B)", "Row 7. Report success. In this example: (success)", "Playing the plan (one illustrative execution: AGV assignment and motion planning choose the real AGV and route): event 1. AGV-1 drives W27 -> P24.", "Playing the plan: event 2. AGV-2 drives W13 -> P15.", "Playing the plan: AGV-2 drives empty P15 -> W13 -> W18 -> W22 -> W25 and stops under T9 (the approach for event 3; AGV assignment adds such moves later).", "Playing the plan: event 3. AGV-2 lifts T9, carries it W25 -> W22 -> P23 and lowers it. The destination P23 is illustrative: tray assignment fills the '?' later. AGV-2 ends hidden again, now under T9. Every tray and AGV is now where the plan leaves it."]
